pagerduty: PagerDuty incident fired: HIGH — read-replica-queue-length alert (metric: replica.queue.length > 800) for cluster 'users-prod-rr'
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-rr-queueing — severity: P1 — Affected services: search-read, embeddings-read, recommendations
maya: ack — I'm oncall and looking. seeing spike in read latency and lots of client 5xx on read paths. Grafana link: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd/pg-replicas?var-cluster=users-prod-rr
eli: on it too, standing by for metrics. are writes healthy? any replication errors?
maya: writes look fine. primary cpu normal. replication lag reported by exporter shows many replicas with queue depth > 1200 and tail-latencies spiking. p95 read latency ~ 2.3s. traffic pattern suggests a large backfill from embeddings pipeline hitting replicas.
saurabh: paging DB infra team. @saurabh can you confirm replica pod health and kube events?
saurabh: looking — several pods in CrashLoopBackOff for the replica-reader autoparallel process. kube events show OOMKilled on sidecar memcache-syncer. Logs attached:

```
2026-04-21T14:02:12Z replica-reader-5f9fd ctn: OOMKilled: RSS>heap_limit
2026-04-21T14:02:14Z replica-reader-6a3cd connection queue length: 1320
2026-04-21T14:03:01Z replica-reader-7b2ab slow query: SELECT ... (large scan)
```
maya: mitigation plan — 1) throttle embeddings pipeline clients, 2) temporarily shift read-only traffic for non-critical routes to primary or cache, 3) scale up replica count and increase pod memory, 4) restart pods one-at-a-time to drain queues.
ops-bot: Suggested quick action: bump replicas +1 and set memory=6Gi to reduce OOM risk.
maya: executing safe mitigations now. First: add ingress rule to route /api/v1/search?source=async -> primary for 15m via feature-flag.

```
# toggle rollouts-service
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://rollouts.company.internal/flags/read-route --data '{"route":"primary","ttl":900}'
```
eli: also running kubectl to scale deployments (will scale one AZ at a time):

```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment users-read-replica --replicas=4
kubectl -n prod patch deployment users-read-replica -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"replica-reader","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"6Gi"}}}]}}}}'
```
saurabh: started pod restarts in rolling fashion. monitoring for OOMs and replication lag. tailing pg_stat_replication delta.
maya: customer impact — search and embeddings read requests degraded (timeouts/500s) for ~10 minutes before mitigation. writing-heavy flows unaffected. ETA to normalizing: 8-12 minutes after scale stabilizes.
support-oncall: posting proactive note to status page and support queue. drafting message:

"We are investigating increased read latency impacting search and embeddings. Engineers are scaling read replicas and routing non-critical reads to primary. Some users may experience transient 5xx on read endpoints."

incident-bot: PagerDuty note — INC-2026-0421-rr-queueing acknowledged by maya at 2026-04-21T14:05:10Z

pagerduty: Alert escalated to DB Infra (saurabh) due to CrashLoopBackOff on replica-reader pods.

eli: observation — once restart completed and feature-flag routing in place, p95 read latency dropped from 2.3s -> 380ms within two rollouts. replica queue lengths decreasing from ~1200 -> ~200.

maya: continuing to watch for 10m. next step: follow up with embeddings team to add client-side backpressure and smaller page sizes. Also file a follow-up RFC to increase memcache-syncer memory and add OOMScoreAdj.

saurabh: creating a short-term patch to bump memcache-syncer memory to 1Gi and add restartPolicy window. Will open PR after incident.

maya: handing off to eli for the rest of rotation. i'm OOTO in 20m. eli — can you own the post-mortem notes and severity classification? please confirm when you have stable metrics.

eli: taking over. I'll consolidate logs, timeline, and customer impact. will post a short postmortem draft to #incidents within 2 hours. tagging @support-oncall for customer comms follow-through.

support-oncall: acknowledged. will keep status page updated and escalate any enterprise customers who ping support. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-rr-queueing status: mitigated (read routing + replica scale) — monitoring. Page cleared at 2026-04-21T14:19:49Z

pagerduty: Closeable once postmortem uploaded and RCA assigned.

eli: will assign RCA to @saurabh and draft postmortem. final note: consider adding a guardrail alert for replica OOM trend and an automated small-scale circuit-breaker to throttle heavy analytics jobs hitting replicas.

maya: thanks team. nice quick remediation. :clap:
